title: gitcoin frame
tagline: creating a gitcoin grants explorer that also support open frames spec
description: Creating a Gitcoin Grants Explorer can be a fantastic way to contribute to the open-source community further. This explorer would only serve as a platform to view existing Gitcoin Grants but also support the Open Frames spec. By integrating Open Frames, the explorer can provide a standardized and interoperable format for displaying grant data. This would enable users to compare grants across different platforms and make more informed decisions.
how_its_made: i use qwik for the base of the project to create frame and then i also use open grant indexer by gitcoin grants explorer https://grants-stack-indexer-v2.gitcoin.co/graphql , also use frames.js https://framesjs.org/ to parse xmtp message, i also use fly.io to deploy the frame which later on can be seen on warpcast or xmtp to see the gitcoin grants explorer
